description: Per-line blame of a postgres file at any commit, as git blame. ignore_revs skips pgindent commits (.git-blame-ignore-revs); reverse adds the commit that removed each line. Max 2000 lines a call. proposals=true: per line the earliest posted patch that added it. Not git_blame (a file's commit list).

commit.description: Any commit form, a release (17.2) or <ref>@YYYY-MM-DD; default newest release branch

name: blame
